newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek civil aviation staff postpone walkouts.
newsitem.headline: Greek civil aviation staff postpone walkouts.

text.p: Greek civil aviation employees postponed on Tuesday three four-hour walkouts planned for this week pending a meeting with Greek Transport Minister Haris Kastanidis, their union said in a statement.

The walkouts, to press demands for better pay and structural changes in civil aviation, will be held next week after Greek Orthodox Easter if the meeting produces no results, the Confederation of Civil Aviation Unions (OSYPA) said.
All airport staff, except air traffic controllers, are members of OSYPA.
"We will wait for the minister to deliver what he has promised," OSYPA president Vassilis Alevizopoulos told Reuters. "If nothing is done we will go ahead with the walkouts after Easter."
The work stoppages would start at 0900 GMT next Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, threatening disruption to flights.
OSYPA wants Greece's civil aviation authority to have more independence from the government and demands that the government honours pledges for more bonus and overtime pay.
